During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|New Republic Special Forces]] strike force undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Zin Taal]] in order to capture the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] base of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit known as the [[First Sun Mobile Regiment]].<ref name="SMUIU" />
